name: Deep Reaches
summary: The Deep Reaches is a disputed underground mine situated deep within the central Stonetalon Mountains. Both the Alliance and the Horde have tunneled into the cavern from opposing sides, sparking a deadly subterranean confrontation between dwarven prospectors and local orc forces.

sections.title: A Clashing Excavation
sections.body: What began as separate excavation efforts quickly escalated into a subterranean warzone. The dwarven Explorers' League drove tunnels into the rock to claim the mountain's rich mineral veins, only to breach an opening directly into the rear approaches of the Horde stronghold at Krom'gar Fortress. With their base compromised from beneath, orc assassins surged into the shafts to silence the miners, leaving the surviving Alliance workers cut off and desperately attempting to collapse the tunnels to seal out the onslaught.

sections.title: Chaos in the Deeps
sections.body: The Horde's excavation efforts have fared little better. While their fighters push deeper into the dwarven shafts, the Horde's own workers accidentally disturbed the fragile subterranean balance, awakening Raging Earth Elementals. These furious stone spirits rampaged through the lower works, slaughtering miners and trapping hapless peons in isolated nooks. Now, both sides struggle to salvage equipment and rescue stranded personnel while fighting each other and the awakened earth itself.

faq.answer: The Deep Reaches is a contested mine in the central Stonetalon Mountains where Alliance and Horde excavations accidentally breached each other's networks deep beneath the rock.

faq.q: Who is currently fighting inside the mine?
faq.answer: The conflict primarily involves the Alliance's dwarven Explorers' League defending their dig sites against Horde assassins from Krom'gar Fortress, while both sides must contend with rampaging earth elementals.

faq.q: Why are there earth elementals inside the tunnels?
faq.answer: Aggressive digging on the Horde side of the excavation disturbed the subterranean spirits of Stonetalon, causing Raging Earth Elementals to awaken and overrun the lower tunnels.

faq.q: Why are there Lordaeron flags near the Alliance entrance?
faq.answer: Alongside the standard Stormwind banners, flags bearing the crest of Lordaeron mark the expedition, representing northern refugees and veterans who joined the Alliance forces operating in Kalimdor.

angles.text: The rich stone of Stonetalon drew both factions to dig, but reckless excavation caused cave-ins and awakened violent earth elementals.
The Explorers' League needs courageous fighters to rescue trapped dwarven miners and seal off the shafts before Krom'gar assassins completely overrun the site.
